Pullman Hanoi - The Hotel
Pullman Hanoi - Luxury hotel
The Hotel
The Pullman Hanoi adds warmth to urban dwelling. A place for living, meeting, exchanging. Not just a place to rest. Even the busiest schedule allows a moment to enjoy the cosmopolitan Pullman Hanoi. With 237 impeccable rooms and suites, La Cheminée Restaurant and Mint Bar, Pullman Hanoi proposes the right balance between relaxation and sociability.

Pullman Hanoi - Rooms & Suites
Pullman Hanoi - Luxury hotel - Rooms & Suites
Home
Rooms & Suites
Rooms & Suites
A New Stay Experience Awaits – Beautifully Designed Guest Rooms Coming Soon for Your Comfort and Relaxation.
Dear Valuable guests,
We are delighted to announce the upcoming introduction of our newly renovated luxury guest rooms, located on the 3rd, 4th, and 5th floors of Pullman Hanoi.
Elegantly designed with a contemporary aesthetic, our newly renovated rooms seamlessly blend modern luxury with exceptional comfort. Inspired by the rich culture and charm of Hanoi, subtle local touches have been thoughtfully woven into every detail, creating a warm and inviting retreat where you can relax, recharge, and enjoy an even more memorable stay.
As we complete the final stages of this enhancement project, you may experience some minor noise or temporary inconvenience during your stay. We sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause and greatly appreciate your patience.
Thank you for your continued trust and support. We look forward to welcoming you to Pullman Hanoi soon
Best regards,
Hotel management team
